ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
graph-retriever provides graph traversal retrieval that combines
unstructured vector similarity with structured document traversal. It
lets retrievers walk edges between documents (defined by metadata) so
related context can be pulled in alongside the nearest-neighbor matches,
independent of any particular vector store. Part of the datastax/graph-rag
project.
about.summary: Retriever combining unstructured similarity and structured document traversal.

name: graph-retriever
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.8.0"

package:
  name: graph-retriever
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/g/graph-retriever/graph_retriever-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e61f1cb27184e8d4559ece6de0a6ea18920908ffbae945051f9a01380af73347
  patches:
    - patches/0001-drop-pytest-from-runtime-deps.patch

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - immutabledict >=4.2.1
    - numpy >=1.26.4
    - typing_extensions >=4.12.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - graph_retriever
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/graph-retriever/
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Retriever combining unstructured similarity and structured document traversal.
  repository: https://github.com/datastax/graph-rag
  documentation: https://datastax.github.io/graph-rag
  description: |
    graph-retriever provides graph traversal retrieval that combines
    unstructured vector similarity with structured document traversal. It
    lets retrievers walk edges between documents (defined by metadata) so
    related context can be pulled in alongside the nearest-neighbor matches,
    independent of any particular vector store. Part of the datastax/graph-rag
    project.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
